messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert firing for service 'shared-redis-prod' - rule 'redis-maxclients' - primary: redis-prod-01 - 2798761234

pagerduty-bot: PAGER: pagerduty.incident/INC-8421 fired and auto-duplicated (3 duplicates) - escalation policy: oncall-sre -> engineering-lead

alex chen: acked in pd and taking initial triage. seeing a flood of new connections to redis-prod-01, socket errors in app logs. tagging @ravi for DB handoff.

maria gonzalez: noticed increased 5xx on API gateway, likely downstream cache errors. rolling 1m error-rate: 9.8% up from 0.4% baseline.

alex chen: quick snapshot: redis-prod-01 maxclients=10000, current clients=10005, evictions+refuses in logs. p99 read latency ~120ms (normal <5ms).

leo kim: past 5m connection histogram shows spike from a single IP range (10.240.32.0/20). could be a bad rollout or retry storm.

ravi singh: jumping in. can we put redis-prod-01 into 'limited mode' to stop accepting new writes? or apply firewall rule to drop the noisy subnet?

alex chen: trying a soft mitigation: adding a temporary iptables DROP for 10.240.32.0/20 on redis-prod-01 (will propagate to other nodes in cluster after coord). executing now:

```
# on redis-prod-01 (run as root)
iptables -I INPUT -s 10.240.32.0/20 -j DROP
echo "added drop for noisy subnet" >> /var/log/incident-actions.log
```

alex chen: applied on primary, connections dropped. client count fell to ~9980 and latency improving to ~30ms. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Note: Auto-duplicates suppressed. escalation pending if no ack by next level in 8m.

oncall-sre: quick customer impact note: a subset of realtime features for ~18% of customers on region-us-east saw transient errors between 2798761200 - 2798761500. We'll fill post-incident numbers.

maria gonzalez: API team is setting retry-backoff on the gateway for cache errors to reduce reconnection flood. pushing config in 2m: `gateway.retry.backoff=linear(50ms->500ms)`

ravi singh: looking at redis conf - we can safely bump `maxclients` to 12000 on secondaries and 11000 on primary as a short window but need a config deploy with restart. prefer avoid restart if we can. alternatives: scale out ephemeral pool nodes or temporarily divert traffic to read replicas.

leo kim: proposing traffic shaping at the proxy layer: apply token-bucket throttle to noisy service to cap reconnections. rolling a route rule now.

alex chen: handing off — I need to step out for another high-priority page in 30m. @ravi please take lead. I'll remain reachable for 10m.

ravi singh: taking lead. plan: 1) keep iptables block for 10m 2) apply gateway retry-backoff 3) throttle noisy client at proxy 4) if client count > 10250 after 10m, increase maxclients on primary to 11000 and notify ops. executing steps 1-3 now.

```
# proxy rule (nginx lua)
if (client_ip in noisy_set) then
  limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=throttle:10m rate=10r/s;
end
```

ravi singh: proxy throttling rolled, gateway backoff live. metrics show steady drop in new connections. current clients 10010 -> 9992 over last 3m.

pagerduty-bot: INC-8421 acknowledged by alex chen, assigned to ravi singh. Escalation cancelled.

maria gonzalez: customer impact summary (prelim): ~12% of realtime requests returned 5xx intermittently; overall API error budget burned ~0.7% in last 10m. no billing-impacting failures reported.

oncall-sre: recommended follow-ups: - audit client-side retry logic for exponential backoff - blacklist misbehaving IPs at edge WAF - schedule config change to increase `maxclients` with a rolling restart plan - run a canary redeploy of the client service (possible bug)

ravi singh: will coordinate config PR for `maxclients` bump and post roll restart plan. creating incident ticket INC-8421 in Jira and adding action items.

alex chen: reaction: :white_check_mark: Good work. leaving handoff note in pagerduty and marking out-of-shift. please ping if we need a full incident war room.

incident-bot: System note: duplicate pager events suppressed. incident INC-8421 is now in "mitigating" state.

ravi singh: final status for thread: mitigations holding, traffic normalized, continuing monitoring for 30m. will update on final RCA draft and customer comms.

maria gonzalez: I'll draft a short customer-facing postmortem noting transient cache errors and mitigation steps.

leo kim: adding follow-up: add an alert to detect concentrated source IP bursts (new rule request filed).

oncall-sre: closing thread for live mitigation — retain logs and config diffs. last check @2798761899.
